subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should existing write-scoped Gateway clients be intentionally denied when `sessions.create` would change the selected model or thinking level of an adopted explicit keyed session?
rationale: This is an externally observable authorization and upgrade-policy change: source and proof support the mechanics, but only maintainers can choose whether the fail-closed behavior is the permanent contract for existing clients.

options.title: Adopt the admin gate
options.body: Accept the fail-closed behavior for changed existing keyed-session selection, retaining the fresh-create and idempotent write-scope exceptions.

options.title: Preserve legacy writes
options.body: Keep existing write-scoped keyed-session reconfiguration and seek a different security boundary or explicit migration strategy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the admin gate
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed behavior for changed existing keyed-session selection, retaining the fresh-create and idempotent write-scope exceptions.
